metadata.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD (GTA V Enhanced)
metadata.description:
GTA VI-Inspired HUD for GTA V ENHANCED (the 2025 PC version, GTA5_Enhanced.exe). By FBICat. Fan-made and inspired by GTA VI. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Some HUD art is taken from Rockstar's official GTA VI media and belongs to Rockstar Games. No GTA VI game files are included.
THIS IS A FORK of FBICat's VI HUD. Help: our support Discord, discord.gg/C7gE5SHEzH, or a GitHub issue. Please don't ask about it in FBICat's Discord: that one is for his original mod.
Same mod as the Legacy package; the DLC packs are converted to the Enhanced (gen9) resource format with CodeWalker's gen9 writer (the same conversion as CodeWalker's Tools > Convert Assets).
INSTALL - two packages, both to your mods folder 1. This package (the files). 2. GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-RegisterPatch.oiv: registers the HUD's DLC packs in dlclist.xml and raises the gameconfig.xml pools. 3. Optional: GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-Lucia-Enhanced.oiv, for Lucia. ViMinimap.asi must end up next to GTA5_Enhanced.exe; the minimap needs it to draw in fullscreen.
What it installs: the HUD (scripts\GTA6Hud.dll, scripts\Hud\, GTA6Hud.ini), the 3D minimap (scripts\ViMinimap.dll, MiniMap.* data, ViMinimap.asi), and the packs vihudfonts and vihudanims - gen9. - 2.5 features (separate scripts; GTA6Hud.dll is FBICat's, with one 2-byte fix: no automatic Lucia swap): scripts\ViExtras.dll + scripts\ViExtras\ + ViExtras.ini honor, crosshair, focus, skills, NPC memory, crash cam, binoculars, radio, nitrous, wanted stars and box, police lights scripts\ViWasted.dll + ViWasted.ini WASTED / BUSTED scripts\ViCustoms.dll + scripts\ViCustoms\ + ViCustoms.ini Leonida Customs (GPL-3) scripts\ViCrouch.dll + scripts\ViCrouch\ + ViCrouch.ini crouch and crawl (GPL-3) No music: put your own mp3/wav files in scripts\Hud\Music and scripts\Hud\Radio\CustomMusic.
Changes in 2.5.1 - Lucia is a separate download now: GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-Lucia-Enhanced.oiv (install it after this one and the RegisterPatch). This package is the HUD alone, and much smaller. - WASTED / BUSTED show every time, not just once a session, and frame the vehicle when you die in one. - Lucia: no more freeze when you load a save you quit as her. She only changes from the character wheel now. - Nitrous is on Left Shift (X / Square on a pad); Left Alt is GTA's character wheel. - Police only shoot to kill when you're armed at 3+ stars; otherwise they tase and arrest you. - Binoculars are on the weapon wheel (hold Tab, or LB on a pad), not on B. - GTA's own on-foot camera: no zooming in when you aim or fire, and V zooms out again. - The crawl moves its legs: each knee draws up as the opposite arm reaches, then pushes.
Changes in 2.5 (full list: CHANGELOG.md on GitHub) - Ported from the FiveM version: WASTED / BUSTED, honor, crosshair and kill marks, Focus, skills and gym, NPC memory, the FiveM crash cam, binoculars and radio, nitrous (in a car with a bottle), Leonida Customs (drive into an LS Customs garage), crouch (Left Ctrl twice) and crawl (Right Ctrl), the four-state wanted stars and wanted box, and directional police lights. - Fixed: Legacy black screen after dying; wanted box flickering; a crash while driving (traffic variety is off). - Lucia is no longer lent to the story characters near mission markers ([Lucia] MissionRange = 0).
Requirements (not included) - Script Hook V for Enhanced and Script Hook V .NET Enhanced (SHVDNE), not the normal Script Hook V .NET - A mods-folder loader for Enhanced (OpenIV.asi only works with Legacy)
Known issues on Enhanced - 2.2's random crashes (a wrong memory read in Script Hook V .NET Enhanced) are fixed; if it still crashes, send the logs below. - With NaturalVision Enhanced: add the 4 packs to NVE's onigiri\common\data\dlclist.xml and keep NVE's gameconfig.xml (see INSTALL-ENHANCED.md). - Problems: send scripts\GTA6Hud.perf.log, scripts\GTA6Hud.error.log, scripts\ViExtras.log and ScriptHookVDotNet.log.

metadata.licence: Personal use. By FBICat. Contains art cut from Rockstar's official GTA VI media (property of Rockstar Games) and the Grand Figma Kit VI (CC BY 4.0). Minimap based on "GTA VI MiniMap (3D Buildings)" by moddims. 2.5 ports from GTA-VI-UI-and-HUD-for-FiveM by Geckomacabre: ViCustoms.dll, ViCrouch.dll and ViWasted.dll are GPL-3 (source on GitHub, licence beside them); the radio code is PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (scripts\ViExtras\Radio\LICENSE.md); Anton font by Vernon Adams, SIL OFL 1.1.
